transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Mr. Chen, thank you for coming back to see me today. I wanted to talk to you about your appointment papers.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: My papers.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. I looked at the papers we gave you when you left the hospital. I saw that something is not right.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Not right?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: This is a difficult thing to tell you. I made a mistake on your form.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Mistake?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. I wrote down a clinic for you to visit. But that clinic does not take your insurance. Your insurance will not pay for that doctor.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I go there. I try call. They say no.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know. I am very sorry. I am the one who wrote the wrong clinic on your paper. That was my fault.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I do not know where go now.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I can see that this is very confusing for you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yes. Confusing. I want help.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I call them. They say no. I feel... bad.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I hear you. It is frustrating to try to get help and be told no.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I just want see doctor.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I know. I am sorry again that I gave you the wrong information.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Why wrong?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: There was a mix up with the names of the clinics on my computer. But that is not an excuse. I should have checked your insurance first.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Now what?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Here is what we will do. I have a new paper here. Look at this name. This is the New Hope Clinic.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: New Hope?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. New Hope Clinic. They take your insurance. I have already called them for you.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: You call?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. They are expecting you. I want you to take this paper and go there this Thursday at ten in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Thursday. Ten.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Correct. On Thursday at ten. You will take this paper and your insurance card. You show them the paper.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I go there.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. And if you have any trouble getting there, or if the clinic says something different, I want you to call me right here at this number. Here is my direct phone number on the paper.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I call you?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Yes. Call me immediately if it is not working. I will make sure you get seen.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Okay. Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I am going to wait here with you while you look at the address. Does the address on the paper look clear to you?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: It is... far?

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: It is a bit further than the other one. It is on Main Street. Do you have a ride to Main Street?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: My son. He take me.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: That is good. Your son can drive you to Main Street on Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: I really apologize for the stress this caused you, Mr. Chen. I am glad we caught this now.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: You are welcome. Let's double check that phone number one more time. Can you read the number back to me?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Five five five... zero one zero two.

transcript.speaker: Resident
transcript.text: Exactly. If anything goes wrong, call that number. I will be waiting to help you.

H.justification: Resident allows the patient to finish all turns, maintains a slow pace, and never interrupts.

E.justification: Error named in the 3rd turn ('I made a mistake on your form'), uses lay language, and checks comprehension twice (address and phone number).

A.justification: Direct apologies used ('I am very sorry', 'I really apologize') and resident takes full personal responsibility ('That was my fault').

R.justification: Resident names specific emotions ('confusing', 'frustrating') and references the patient's specific experience of being told 'no' by the clinic.

T.justification: Plan includes specific next steps (New Hope Clinic), timeline (Thursday at ten), patient role (take paper/insurance card), and prevention/recourse (direct phone number).
